subject: Mythology
title: The Sacred Ballgame: Sport of the Gods
description: A fast breakdown of The Sacred Ballgame: Sport of the Gods for builders.

hook.text: The Maya invented a sport where the losers were sometimes sacrificed. The ball court was a portal to the underworld.

buildup.text: Players used their hips, elbows, and knees to pass a heavy rubber ball through stone rings mounted high on walls.

discovery.text: The game re-enacted the Hero Twins' battle against the death gods. Every match was a myth played out in real time.

twist.text: Some scholars now believe it was the winners, not the losers, who were sacrificed — dying in glory was an honor.

climax.text: Over 1,500 ball courts have been found across Mesoamerica. The game lasted 3,000 years, outliving empires.

punchline.text: A rubber ball connected heaven, earth, and the underworld for millennia.

quiz.question: What did the Mesoamerican ballgame symbolically re-enact?
options: The creation of the sun and moon
The Hero Twins' battle against the death gods
The migration of the Aztec people
